::: {#def-markov-chain}
#### Markov chain

A sequence of random variables $\vth^{(1)}, \vth^{(2)}, \ldots$
is a **Markov chain** if, for every $t$,
the conditional distribution of $\vth^{(t+1)}$ given all the earlier values
depends only on $\vth^{(t)}$:

$$
\p\paren{\vth^{(t+1)} \mid \vth^{(t)}, \vth^{(t-1)}, \ldots, \vth^{(1)}}
=
\p\paren{\vth^{(t+1)} \mid \vth^{(t)}}.
$$
:::
